verdict.rationale: Lago's API and self-hosted docs imply data can be retrieved (invoice download, CSV export for revenue analytics, comprehensive API reference), giving some data-portability, but there is no explicit documentation of bulk export tooling for subscriptions/usage records or of porting stored payment methods to another provider. missing for 10: dedicated data-export/migration feature, explicit payment-method portability mechanism, evidence of bulk subscription/usage export.
